changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from ClimMob v3 spreadsheet export (project not in the v3 dump) records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Sweetpotato tricot trial FASou2021, southern Ghana, 2021
study.description: On-farm tricot evaluation of sweetpotato varieties and clones in Ghana. Farmers ranked three genotypes at harvest for vigour, drought tolerance, virus symptoms, maturity, vine yield, root size, root number, weevil damage, yield, marketability, taste, overall performance and wish to grow again, and compared each with their local variety.
study.source_platform: ClimMob v3 spreadsheet export (project not in the v3 dump)

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised

data_producer.name: International Potato Center (CIP)
data_producer.program: Scaling RTB crop variety validation and diffusion using farmer citizen science in Ghana and Rwanda (RTB Scaling Fund, 2020 to 2021); SweetGAINS
data_producer.partner: CSIR-Crops Research Institute (CSIR-CRI); CSIR-Savanna Agricultural Research Institute (CSIR-SARI)
